::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IIT Hyderabad-incubated fabless startup founded by Sumit Bhat and R Sai Chandra Teja, specialising in power-management ICs for battery-free IoT.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Multi-input energy-harvesting power management ICs that let IoT devices run without batteries, harvesting power from multiple ambient sources.
